title: Geologic map of the Zirconia quadrangle, Greenville County, South Carolina and Henderson County, North Carolina
citation: Garihan, J.M., and Ranson, W.A., 2008, Geologic map of the Zirconia quadrangle, Greenville County, South Carolina and Henderson County, North Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Geologic Quadrangle Map GQM-39, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Zirconia quadrangle GQM-39 (2008, v3.1), Greenville County SC and Henderson County NC. Recorded SC-relevant units and structures; Henderson Gneiss (Potato Hill) and the 372 Ma Freeman mine pegmatite age are North Carolina localities and are not recorded. Strike/dip and fold symbols without coordinates. No drill holes. SUBSURFACE: section A-A' interpretive.
